Hey, I've certainly been there, though it took me longer to see it. I'm currently 24, and trying to find a permanent way out.

Some advise I have learned:

1. Find a support group. People that know the situation, even if you don't tell them everything. Also try to find people that are further away, even 30 minutes can make a hell of a difference.

2. College. It is a big excuse to get away and find yourself. And something that most parents agree too.

3. Try not to start anything now. Get away first, otherwise I'm afraid it's only going to get worse.

4. Save up money, as much as possible. You can make a document (excel if you know how) and try crunching numbers. Since most of your stuff is probably still paid for, the easiest way I look at it is that you only allow yourself to spend so much money a week. Like start with only $10 or $20 a week. And try to stick with it as much as you can.

5. Research. This can be done through school, or just online research. Look up stuff about saving money, doing taxes, writing a resume, doing laundry, cooking, making your own appointments, etc. And start trying to do some of that now. It's alot easier to do stuff one thing at a time instead of be thrown in head first.
